+# CLAUDE.md

+This file provides guidance to Claude Code and agents working on this repository.

+## Project Overview
+
+`@stepdown/analyzer` — A TypeScript AST analyzer and fixer that enforces the stepdown rule: callers appear ABOVE callees (high-level first, low-level last). Also detects nested function declarations that appear before logic within a scope.
+
+## Project Conventions
+
+- Each analysis (violation type) must have a fix implementation. Add fixture in `src/violation-coverage.ts` and ensure fix reduces violations.
+- Use bun instead of node.
+    - `npm run` > `bun run`
+    - `npx` > `bunx`
+- No Barrel Files. Import directly from source files.
+    - ❌ DON'T: `import { foo } from "./index"` or `import { foo } from "./folder"`
+    - ✅ DO: `import { foo } from "./folder/foo"`
+- Use Mermaid for diagrams.
+- Do not fix unused functions or parameters with underscores — delete them.
+- Commit pre-existing uncommitted changes before starting new work to avoid push-hook conflicts.
+
+## Subagent Scope Boundaries
+
+When dispatching subagents for bugfixes or targeted changes, include explicit scope constraints:

`install.ps1` warns on ARM64 but does not exit, so it proceeds to download x64 binaries.

`remove-buildinfo.ts` contains a borderline WHAT comment in an empty catch block.

`tests/rule-fix-coverage` imports `register-default-rules` as a side effect, creating a test-order dependency and leaking abstraction.

<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Digging deeper into additional potential issues.

install.ps1 uses Write-Error for ARM64 failures. With $ErrorActionPreference set to Stop, this likely terminates execution. Severity is medium or low.

release.yml hardcodes SHA256SUMS and asset filenames. These duplicate RELEASE_COMPILE_TARGETS and releaseAssetName. They risk drifting out of sync.

build.ts uses Bun.$ for mkdir. compile-release.ts uses fs/promises. The two scripts use different patterns for the same operation.

compileNativeCli calls process.exit(1). This side effect leaks from a library-style helper and makes testing harder.

FileService ignores via post-filter. This forces glob to walk node_modules and other ignored directories. Old code passed ignore directly to glob instead. Performance suffers and the approach is leaky.

applyIgnore redundantly converts paths to POSIX when they are already converted.

parseArgs silently ignores unknown arguments without validation.

The target parameter accepts a raw string instead of a strict ReleaseCompileTarget union. This bypasses validation against RELEASE_COMPILE_TARGETS.

compile-size-bench.ts duplicates compileNativeCli logic with a copy-paste variation. It calls the CLI directly rather than using Bun.build. This risks divergent behavior between the two paths.

binaryPath in compile-size-bench only checks for .exe on Windows hosts. Cross-compilation scenarios would fail. The resolveCompiledPath helper handles this more robustly.

compile-native.ts mixes useful explanatory comments with redundant JSDoc on obvious items.

build.ts contains a redundant host path check. compileNativeCli already exits if the native binary is missing, yet build.ts validates hostOutfile again. The return value from compileNativeCli is also ignored.

package.json contains a malformed postbuild script: `"bun run --shell bun remove-buildinfo"`. This looks like a double bun invocation.

Idempotency tests inline replaceAll logic instead of using a shared helper. This is copy-paste duplication.

register-default-rules imports a side-effect module. Test order could break because of it. Severity is medium.

install.ps1 uses case-sensitive `-notcontains` for PATH checks. Windows path casing differences could cause false positives. Severity is low.

install.sh lacks a trap for mid-curl failures. `set -e` catches them instead. This is acceptable.

`compileNativeCli` accepts a raw `string` for its `target` parameter rather than the `ReleaseCompileTarget` union. This is stringly typed.

`CompileNativeOptions` carries four parameters: minify, sourcemap, target, and outfile. The sprawl is moderate.

build.ts exposes three overlapping configuration paths: compileOnly, target, and env. This sprawls parameter options.

compile-size-bench.ts computes megabytes from bytes twice in a row. This is minor redundancy.

Several JSDoc comments describe what the code does. This is mild WHAT commentary.

FileService’s loss of blank lines between methods is a style issue, not a quality flag.

Reconsidering FileService: the old code passed ignore directly to glob, while the new code filters after glob. The end result is identical, so the change is purely cosmetic.

FileService glob without ignore risks permission errors or symlink loops inside node_modules. Severity is medium.

install.ps1 relies on Write-Error with Stop to halt on ARM64 failures. It omits exit codes or throws. This is fragile if ErrorActionPreference is changed later. Severity is medium.

build.ts and compile-release.ts duplicate the same asset-name and outfile formatting. This is copy-paste sprawl.
</details></think>

## Code quality findings (simplify pass)

### High
| Loc | Issue |
|-----|--------|
| `src/services/FileService.ts:15-17` | Dropped glob `ignore`; walks full tree (incl. `node_modules`) then post-filters. Correctness may hold; perf/correctness risk on large repos / odd trees. |
| `scripts/compile-native.ts:16` + `scripts/build.ts:33-47` | `target?: ReleaseCompileTarget \| string` + unvalidated CLI/env string — union is decorative; bad target fails late. |
| `.github/workflows/release.yml:35-39,60-65` | Asset names hardcoded; drift vs `RELEASE_COMPILE_TARGETS` / `releaseAssetName` breaks release. |

### Med
| Loc | Issue |
|-----|--------|
| `scripts/build.ts:63-73` | Redundant existence check after `compileNativeCli` (already exits on miss); return path ignored. |
| `scripts/build.ts:57-61` vs `scripts/compile-release.ts:7-16` | Copy-paste: `releaseAssetName` + strip `.exe` + `dist/release/` outfile. |
| `scripts/compile-size-bench.ts:30-46` | Parallel compile path (`bun` CLI spawn) vs `Bun.build` in `compileNativeCli`; reimplements `.exe` resolve. |
| `scripts/compile-native.ts:67-82` | Helper calls `process.exit(1)` — not reusable/testable; leaky control flow. |
| `scripts/build.ts:60` vs `compile-release.ts:3` | `Bun.$`mkdir -p`` vs `fs.mkdir` — inconsistent mkdir. |
| `FileService.ts:35-37` | Redundant `toPosixPath` on paths already normalized at L16. |
| `tests/file-service.test.ts:7-9` + `tests/idempotency.test.ts:122` | Duplicated `\`→`/` helper / inline replace. |
| `scripts/install.ps1:11-13` | ARM64 uses `Write-Error` (relies on `$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'`) instead of `throw`/`exit`. |
| `tests/rule-fix-coverage.test.ts:3` | Side-effect registry import; order/isolation smell (same pattern as `vic-pipeline.test.ts`). |

### Low
| Loc | Issue |
|-----|--------|
| `scripts/compile-native.ts:1-3,14-15,22` | JSDoc restates names/types (WHAT). Bytecode note at L44-46 is useful WHY. |
| `scripts/compile-size-bench.ts:76-81` | MiB formatted twice. |
| `scripts/build.ts:31-48` | Silent ignore of unknown argv; three knobs (`--target`, `--target=`, `STEPDOWN_COMPILE_TARGET`). |
| `scripts/install.sh:73-82` | Fallback `mkdir` of `~/.local/bin` after failed first mkdir — awkward / near-dead branch. |
| `scripts/remove-buildinfo.ts:5-6` | Fine; catch comment is mild WHAT. |
| `scripts/sync-agents.ts` | Clean; WHY comment OK. |
| `.github/workflows/pages.yml` | Fine; no hacky patterns. |

### Not flagged as bugs (intentional)
- `install.sh` / `install.ps1` parallel logic (shell vs PS unavoidable).
- Host `outfile` without `.exe` + `resolveCompiledPath` compensation — awkward but intentional.

No fixes applied (review only).
